value.rationale: A thermodynamically meaningful sufficient construction demonstrates that separated Schottky peaks do not require unequal adjacent bare gaps. The rigorous integer cutoff and diverging peak heights with a vanishing inter-peak test value quantify entropic peak splitting; this offers a sharp caveat for inferring distinct excitation gaps from observed calorimetric maxima. No experimentally realizable multiplet structure is claimed.
